name: supreme-coding-guidelines
description: The .ah skill bundle for Claude Code. Combines token compression, surgical coding behavior, disciplined diagnosis, TDD, architectural control, full-project audit discipline, genuine problem-solving with tabular deliverables, principal AI engineering discipline for production AI/ML/LLM/MLOps/LLMOps systems, a latest-always NPM/NPX/Node engineering discipline, a principal content craft discipline for SEO/SEM/Copywriting/Marketing/Writing with six integrated persuasion frameworks, a multi-persona deliberation council, a research-grade benchmarking discipline, a living-diagram companion, and a first-in-the-world AI governance and compliance discipline (ISO/IEC 42001 + EU AI Act + NIST AI RMF) through the Teleological Semantic Format (.ah) created by David C. Cavalcante (originator of MAIC™, HIM™, and NHE™). Auto-discovers eleven skills from the skills/ directory: ah-parser (one-time bootstrap of the .ah grammar with three-mode output protocol), supreme-coding-guidelines (always-on behavioral rules), supreme-project-audit (on-demand evidence-driven audit), supreme-problem-solving (on-demand analyze-verify-diagnose-solve workflow with structured tabular deliverable), supreme-ai-engineering (on-demand AI/ML/LLM/MLOps/LLMOps engineering discipline), supreme-npm-node (on-demand NPM/NPX/NPMJS/Node discipline with latest-version-always policy via ncu -u, TypeScript strict mode, OIDC provenance), supreme-content-craft (on-demand SEO/SEM/Header Binding/Copywriting/Marketing/Writing discipline with AIDA + Cialdini 6 principles + StoryBrand/PAS/FAB/Schwartz/SUCCESs/Ogilvy/Hopkins + Schopenhauer ethical eristic + Joe Girard Law of 250 + Cialdini Pre-Suasion, plus 15 quality tool gates), supreme-council (on-demand multi-perspective deliberation council with four cognitive personas — First-Principle Thinker, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor — running a three-round protocol of individual outputs, anonymous peer review, and synthesis that preserves dissent; integrates Spec-Kit phasing, Klein premortem, Cynefin uncertainty handling; never tries to please the user), and supreme-benchmarking (on-demand research-grade benchmarking for AI/ML/LLM/npm inspired by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, Hugging Face, and Unsloth methodologies — four personas applied to benchmark design, statistical rigor gates with CI95 and multi-seed variance, contamination defense with canaries, harness version pinning, tinybench/mitata/hyperfine/size-limit for npm, benchmark cards with bold-best tables and error bars, one-command reproducibility, honest disclosure of negative results, CI regression tracking), and supreme-diagramming (on-demand living-diagram companion that treats architecture/flow/ERD/sequence/class/C4/state diagrams as living versioned artifacts described in a deterministic declarative layer validated by gematria checksum then compiled to portable targets Mermaid/D2/draw.io XML/Excalidraw with no lock-in, describe-first pipeline, deterministic-verification-first with vision only as reinforcement, diagram-as-file-next-to-code diffed in pull requests, memory of prior diagrams, graceful degradation with no heavy desktop dependency), and supreme-ai-governance (on-demand first-in-the-world AI governance and compliance discipline operationalizing ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management System with its clauses 4 to 10, the roughly 38 Annex A controls, the Statement of Applicability, and the AI System Impact Assessment via ISO/IEC 42005:2025; the EU AI Act including risk tiers, GPAI obligations, conformity assessment, FRIA, penalties, and the June 2026 Digital Omnibus timeline; the NIST AI Risk Management Framework GOVERN MAP MEASURE MANAGE; and the global regulatory map across the United States, United Kingdom, China, Canada, Brazil and the OECD, UNESCO, Council of Europe, G7, and UN instruments; integrates with ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO 9001 through the Harmonized Structure; operates through four cognitive lenses — First-Principle Thinker, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor — that never try to please and report real exposure; delivers a gap assessment, Statement of Applicability, control map, evidence register, and remediation roadmap; this is compliance-engineering structure and not legal advice). User code is always preserved verbatim regardless of output mode.
